title: Most expensive booking per class
statementMd:
For each seat class show the booking with the highest fare (booking id, passenger, fare).

Expected columns: `seat_class`, `id`, `passenger`, `fare`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: `ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY seat_class ORDER BY fare DESC)`.
solutionMd:
```sql
WITH r AS (SELECT id, passenger, seat_class, fare, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY seat_class ORDER BY fare DESC, id) AS rn FROM bookings) SELECT seat_class, id, passenger, fare FROM r WHERE rn = 1;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
